name: rosetta-integer-comparison
code:
use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.write_line
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.StringSplitOptions

write("a b: ")

if let entered = read_line() then
    let fields =
        entered.split([' '], StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)

    let first = int.parse(fields[0])
    let second = int.parse(fields[1])

    if first < second then
        write_line("{first} is less than {second}")
    fi

    if first == second then
        write_line("{first} is equal to {second}")
    fi

    if first > second then
        write_line("{first} is greater than {second}")
    fi
fi

use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.write_line
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.StringSplitOptions

write("a b: ")

if let entered = read_line() then
    let fields =
        entered.split([' '], StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)

    let first = int.parse(fields[0])
    let second = int.parse(fields[1])

    if first < second then
        write_line("{first} is less than {second}")
    fi

    if first == second then
        write_line("{first} is equal to {second}")
    fi

    if first > second then
        write_line("{first} is greater than {second}")
    fi
fi
